remarks: Bright & Beautiful 2-Bedroom Garden Ranch in Norwest Condominium Complex! Discover this freshly painted, wonderfully maintained 2-bedroom, 1-bathroom home in the highly desirable Norwest Condominium Complex-conveniently located near highways, public transportation, parks, shopping, Minutes from from Westport Train station and so much more! This first-floor end-unit garden ranch features gorgeous refinished hardwood floors and an open-concept living and dining area with sliding glass doors that lead to a private deck-perfect for enjoying your morning coffee or unwinding while overlooking the lush, expansive green space. Both bedrooms are filled with abundant natural light, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. The unit also includes an in-unit washer and dryer for added convenience. Enjoy fantastic community amenities, including a clubhouse, in-ground pool, and playground. The monthly rent includes heat and hot water, plus two assigned parking spots, just steps from the unit, Ample visitor parking is also available. Norwest is about a half mile loop, with beautiful walkways and is a great place for bike rides, walks and jogs. Pet-friendly! (Up to 2 pets allowed with landlord approval.) See agent remarks. Don't miss out on this charming home-schedule a viewing today! Parking spaces #91 & #92.
